name: Barbarian Dexterous Barbarian
body:
“Fast as a mongoose.”

As a dexterous barbarian, you have the following class feature.

Dexterous Barbarian (Ex)

Whenever you would gain a morale bonus to Strength, you instead gain an equivalent morale bonus to Dexterity. You take no penalty to AC when raging.
